recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Pranks, Tricksters and a Ukrainian Statue", "body": "Gabe opened the discussion with a statue in Ukraine that he credited to the Enter the Stars channel, explaining that visitors were told a mirror lay under its shoe, so bending to look let the statue's other hand reach their pocket. Gabe tied this to the coin under Obama's foot in the film and to the trickster archetype. One of the hosts argued that the powers behind such imagery treated their actions as pranks that only count once revealed, and another voice offered a crown to clown letter swap. Andrea added that belief itself did not matter, because other people would believe regardless."}, {"title": "The Film as a Seasonal Sky Clock", "body": "Throughout the evening the group read the film as a walk through the year, matching scenes to the zodiac wheel, the solstices and the equinoxes. Participants placed the opening in the fall and the ending in spring, and linked one scene to a Libra moment. One of the hosts described the Lions Gate alignment and the Big Dipper pouring out in August as the best time to cast spells. A participant credited Marty Leeds with the idea that a coffin shape sits inside Ophiuchus, and another connected its heel to the scorpion's tail. They also read the missing seed in the yin yang as a removed masculine principle."}, {"title": "The Winter Skeleton and Voodoo Death Gods", "body": "When the top-hatted skeleton appeared near the film's halfway point, participants read him as the winter sun and as the death and magician cards at once. One speaker traced the word daisy to days eye and noted its old English spelling. Others raised Baron Samedi, the Creole voodoo figure, and one participant connected his name to the Sanskrit word samadhi. The party horn was discussed as a party snake. Another speaker described a Nescafe commercial, which they said aired right after the Kennedy assassination, as a hypnosis ritual, and others called the story convoluted and possibly a psy-op."}, {"title": "Christ Imagery, Halos and the Fish", "body": "Joshua explained that in the Orthodox faith the light around the Christ figure is called the uncreated light, which he said represents the anointing or seal received by saints. Earlier, one speaker read Luke 3 and John 14 against the scene and compared the starry background to an Orthodox resurrection icon. Later, one speaker treated the fish leaping into the boat as the 153 fish of the Gospel of John and counted 153 as the seventeenth triangular number. Joshua joked that all those fish made the scene a fish fry, and the group then moved on to the fire and sacrifice symbolism."}, {"title": "Time, Notre Dame and Closing Weaves", "body": "In the second half participants read the speeding frames as time acceleration, with one voice doubting the James Webb telescope images and another citing physics reports about extra dimensions. Later, participants read the collapsing church as the Notre Dame fire, and one speaker asked whether the fire could have been a ploy to remove a relic of the crown. Another claimed the pope ordered Vatican assets recalled into one bank. One speaker announced a long future project on the nine bands and the nine implements of Christ's suffering. Chance closed by thanking about sixty live viewers and inviting Andrea and Joshua back."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Andrea (@thecozycrone), Joshua Donohew and Slick Dissident return to Vibe Rant to continue our assessment of the short film, I Pet Goat 2. What cryptic prophecies have been encoded in the latter half of this strange and absurd animation?
